description: EXP-005 [P4 augmentation]: P4's train-time augmentation [A] - horizontal flip 0.5, random crop scale 0.8-1.0, colour jitter +-20% brightness/contrast/saturation, no rotation - replacing EXP-001's augmentation (which has +-15 deg rotation and no saturation jitter). Saturation jitter is a new optional AugmentConfig field [D], default off. Everything else identical to EXP-001.
